entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: A major green-aligned ancient forest on Kamigawa made of huge cedars, home to many kami, orochi and kitsune.

entities.name: Boseiju
entities.description: The oldest and tallest tree on Kamigawa, a huge twisted cedar whose name means she who shelters all.

entities.name: Towashi
entities.description: A city that grew into the Jukai and engulfed the grove of Boseiju; now Kamigawa's metropolitan center.

entities.name: Kami
entities.description: Spirits of the Jukai who attacked Towashi's builders after their homes were destroyed.

entities.name: The Emperor
entities.description: The emperor who brokered an agreement between Towashi and the kami.

entities.name: Order of Jukai
entities.description: An order established to preserve nature and reverence for the spirits, opposed to reckless use of technology.

entities.name: Jugan
entities.description: The spirit who watches over Jukai Forest.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: A war between mortals and kami, after which the Order of Jukai was established.

events.summary: Part of Jukai was destroyed during the soratami invasion.
events.quote: Part of Jukai was destroyed during the soratami invasion

events.summary: Towashi's growth consumed the edges of Jukai and enclosed the grove of Boseiju, displacing forest kami.
events.quote: As Towashi's boundaries stretched outward, the city began encroaching upon the ancient Jukai Forest, gradually consuming its edges.

events.summary: The angered kami attacked, demolishing new structures and cursing those responsible.
events.quote: the kami unleashed their wrath by demolishing recently built structures and casting curses upon those responsible for the desecration.

events.summary: The emperor brokered an agreement: Towashi would stop growing into the forest, Boseiju could not be cut down, and Jukai closed to mortals without the kami's permission.
events.quote: He brokered an agreement that the city would halt further growth into the forest.

events.summary: The Order of Jukai was established about 1,200 years after the Kami War.
events.quote: the Order of Jukai was established to preserve nature and reverence for the spirits.

relations.quote: Jukai Forest is watched over by Jugan

relations.note: The tree stood in the Jukai.
relations.quote: Jukai was the location of Boseiju

relations.note: Attacked it over the forest's destruction.
relations.quote: These guardian spirits, angered by the destruction of their homes, retaliated fiercely.
the Order of Jukai has built temples to make sure the kami feel welcomed
